item.tib: gcod chen nas phyung gsang gcod kyi khang dmigs pa kha 'thor ba sna tshogs
item.coloph: de ltar gang la gang 'kho ba'i/ kha bsgyur dmigs pa sna tshogs 'di/ gcod chen dag las bsdus pa ste/ de yang rang 'dod ma yin la/ rang gi bla ma sogs gong mas/ gsang gcod dag la gcod chen gyis (gyi/)kha bskang rung zhes gsungs nas su/ kha 'thor shog byang mang po snang / de dag som nyi 'dug ste/ khra ther dmigs se zhi drag sogs/ sngon nas 'di la sbyong nges pa/ 'di ltar bgyis pa 'thad pa rigs/ 'o na snga yod de ka la/ gsar rtsom dgos sam zhe na ni/ nam dgos dmigs pa nam zin dus/ blo nas bris dang blo rten tsam/ gang yin dang ni gang min pa/ mi shes 'dres pa mi 'khrugs phyir/ nam rgyal ming gis gzhigs gzhigs nas/ nam dgos dus su sla sla ru/ nam zhig bstan 'gror dmigs dmigs te/ nam kyang (yang) brtson pas bsgrig bsgrigs pa/ bdag gzhan kun la phan pa'i rgyu/ rnam dkar 'bras bu rab smin nas/ 'dod pa'i phungs pa sel ba dang / bsam pa'i don chen 'grub par shog/
